name: Mietwen Milirose
source:
Mietwen Milirose is a feared and beloved woman of terrifying esteem. Even before marrying the Grand General, she had been famous among her people; an assassin of exceptional skill, who did what assassins mustn't and became known for her face and name. Her marriage came at a fortunate time in her career; no longer able to depend on anonymity, a notable marriage to, arguably, the most powerful man in Gha'alia kept her out of the Gha'alian Alluvion's typical discharge. In a not unrelated event shortly thereafter, the Alluvion was dismantled and replaced by the Gha'alian Masks. Mietwen was appointed Mask Commander.

Mietwen remained Mask Commander through a series of successful campaigns, until retiring shortly after the birth of her seventh son. She has become more and more reclusive in recent years, though is still frequently seen at her husband's side in less formal settings. Though she is no longer Mask Commander and her days as an assassin are long behind her, many suspect she is still very much active. Whether or not this is with Gawloyes' sanction or outside his reach remains the popular question.
